notes:
**Manuscript v0.8.26 highlights:**

- No window can be made smaller than what it shows
- Read as One Document shows colored text readably in the dark theme
- Harvest Figures' quality column reads in the dark theme
- The user guide matches the app
- Version History compares with the "current project"
- The Catalog has its own status bar
- ⌘= and ⇧⌘= in a figure caption make subscript and superscript again
- Every catalog list has a right-click menu and answers Delete, Return and F2
- "Insert at Cursor" is always on the Images toolbar
- Clearer words in the Catalog
- Empty Starred and Footnotes lists say what to do
- The numbers beside catalog rows are explained
- Easier to read and to reach by keyboard
- The dark theme no longer turns Catalog toolbars into gray slabs
- Thesis Format Profile no longer deletes the profile you had selected
- Funder Profile asks before Clear Profile and Delete
- Esc no longer throws away a half-edited profile
- Word Count says "counted", not "tracked"
- Grant exports show progress and can be cancelled
- Journal Summaries: Enter closes the window, and Add explains an added summary
- Submission Readiness names citation styles by their titles
- Smaller wording fixes in the manuscript package
- Esc no longer throws away changes in Preferences, Manage Phrases, the template editors or Bibliography Sections
- Preferences is grouped by subject
- Preferences remembers its size
- Preferences is readable in the dark theme
- Preferences points to menu items that exist
- Adding a phrase is one window
- A template name already in use is reported in the template editor
- Save as Template says what a template keeps:
- Windows are named for their menu items
- Enter presses the button you expect
- Apply Manuscript Font says what it does
- Personal Dictionary says its changes are saved as you make them
- AI Assist says everything it sends
- A selection that cannot be edited on its own is no longer widened without a word
- Run on Many Sections ticks only the manuscript's text
- Esc no longer throws away a typed instruction
- Picking a saved prompt adds it where the cursor is
- Deleting a saved prompt asks first
- One word for a saved instruction
- Messages that make sense without a title
- AI review findings and the disclosure log are readable in the dark theme and show local time
- Tab moves on from the Run on Many Sections instruction box
- Undo says which history it acts on
- The close prompt tells the truth about autosave
- What you do in the Catalog is reported in the Catalog
- Failures and partial results stay on screen
- One line per section command, and one rule for "nothing to do"
- Cancel says what it left
- Every export names the file it wrote
- A stuck update check can no longer freeze the menu
- Naming prompts stay open until the name is usable
- Save as Template keeps the outline's shape
- Dark theme: headings and navigator colors are readable
- Clearer navigator and start window
- Comments, the Words chip and recovery messages use the app's usual words
- Esc no longer throws away a half-typed reference
- Add Reference fits a small laptop screen
- The co-author merge preview is readable in the dark theme
- A merge option that was refused is in the merge report
- Cancelling a metadata refresh says "cancelled"
- Deleting an article folder can be undone
- Exported reference files say where they went
- Buttons in their platform's order, and Enter presses a button you chose
- Import says "Import"
- Messages point to menus that exist
- Esc no longer throws away typed authors, footnotes or equations
- Start Revision shows what is on the clipboard before pasting it
- The equation preview shows the equation in the dark theme
- The annotation color button shows the true color, with readable text
- Edit Figure's tools sit in two tidy rows
- Button order follows the platform
- Windows fit a small laptop screen
- Authors & Title Page shows five authors at a time,
- "Discard This Revision…" is now "Set This Revision Aside…",
- Export messages say what failed and where the file went

- Messages point to menu items that exist
- A missing converter or dictionary says what to do

- Menu words follow the glossary
